results.name: Phase 1 has no database and only static sites
each static site publishes a directory the public build produces
no secret or dashboard-entered variable in Phase 1
every static site sends CSP, nosniff, frame denial, HSTS, no-referrer on /*
the investor demo is not indexed (X-Robots-Tag noindex)
NODE_VERSION matches .node-version and the Docker base image
one database, paid plan from the spec, tested major version
the database accepts private-network connections only (ipAllowList: [])
database diskSizeGB is 1 or a multiple of 5
database and services share one valid region
services are paid Docker web services with deliberate deploys
dockerfilePath exists and both services build the same image
start commands name real entry points
results.detail: api: node services/enterprise-api/dist/src/main.js · app: node apps/enterprise-web/server/serve.mjs

results.name: pre-deploy: roles (V-1 gate) → migrations → policy, all real entry points
health check paths are served (/health by the API, /healthz by the web server)
the persistent disk is mounted at the image's evidence directory, API only
every environment variable is one the code reads
every variable production requires is declared (API: database, secrets, OIDC, CORS; app: API_URL)
no secret has a literal value (generated, from the database, or entered in the dashboard)
production mode, OIDC, TLS to the database, proxy-aware client addresses
DATABASE_URL comes from the declared database's connection string (the owner)
no development switch: AUTH_MODE is not dev and the web app is in production mode
resource names are unique across both Blueprints

limits: Static check of files only. Not checked here: that Render accepts the files (it validates on Blueprint creation), V-1 (role creation on Render Postgres), V-2 (disk writable by uid 10001), the Docker build itself.
